bases.note: Iran struck the Navy's Bahrain logistics hub on the first day. Regional ports large enough for a carrier remain inside missile range, so supply ships sail to Diego Garcia and the fleet resupplies at sea every five to six days. USS Abraham Lincoln spent about nine months deployed without a port call before USS George Washington relieved it on 20 August.
bases.source: Washington Post (228 structures); Stars and Stripes; Defense News

munitions.note: CSIS estimated roughly a third of Patriot interceptors remained as of 27 July and that rebuilding to pre-war levels would take at least three years. CNN reported about 80% of THAAD and half of Patriot stocks used. The $21bn munitions line in the supplemental is consistent with the estimates the Secretary disputes.

fed_counterpoint.name: Why gold did not actually overtake Treasuries as the world's favourite reserve asset
fed_counterpoint.author: Colin Weiss, Federal Reserve Board
fed_counterpoint.finding: The crossover is a valuation effect driven by private ETF demand since late 2024, not central bank accumulation; by June 2026 foreign official Treasury holdings again exceeded world gold reserves excluding the US in dollar terms. Five legacy holders (US, Germany, Italy, France, IMF) own 52% of official gold and have not added since the 1970s. Foreign officials bought roughly USD 200bn of Treasuries net between 2022 and April 2026.
